title: Rocket 3.0: a new name for RocketGPT chat
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: RocketGPT chat is now called Rocket 3.0. The product name is new; the public chat still uses a third-party AI service.
body: We have renamed the public RocketGPT chat experience to Rocket 3.0. The new name updates the product identity across the website, navigation, and sharing previews.

This is a product rename, not a claim that RocketGPT has trained or deployed its own language model for the public chat. Rocket 3.0 continues to send requests to Pollinations' third-party AI service. A separate experimental RocketGPT fine-tune can be run locally on a Mac.

title: A brighter, simpler RocketGPT
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: RocketGPT's homepage, Rocket 2.0 chat, and NALL-E now share a clean white look, with a page directory to make each experience easier to find.
body: The updated design brings a white background and clearer contrast across the full site, including the Rocket 2.0 chat workspace. The shared navigation now connects Home, Rocket 2.0, and NALL-E.
RocketGPT is the company brand; Rocket 2.0 and NALL-E remain the names of the products. The design is intended to make those destinations easier to recognize and move between.

title: NALL-E image generation, without an API key
imageAlt: Abstract landscape artwork with a bright sun and layered hills.
summary: NALL-E now sends image prompts to a public image service directly from the browser, so trying it does not require setting up an OpenAI key.
body: The image generator uses Pollinations' public image service. Enter a description, choose a shape, and preview the generated image from the NALL-E page.
Because the service is public and third-party, availability and rate limits are controlled by its provider. Prompts are sent to that service, so avoid including sensitive information.

title: Introducing RocketGPT
imageAlt: A green star surrounded by a thin circular orbit.
summary: RocketGPT is the company behind Rocket 2.0 and NALL-E, focused on building and bringing practical AI products to people.
body: The homepage now explains how the RocketGPT brand relates to its products. Rocket 2.0 is a browser-based AI chat workspace, and NALL-E is a text-to-image experience.
The products currently use third-party models and services rather than models trained from scratch by RocketGPT. We aim to identify those providers where they are used.

title: A more reliable Rocket 2.0 chat
imageAlt: A small rocket following a green orbital path against a soft background.
summary: Rocket 2.0 now gives a clearer path through slow or failed responses, including a retry option that keeps your unsent message available.
body: Chat requests have a timeout, and when a request fails, Rocket keeps the message in the composer so it can be retried. Failed turns are not added to the conversation context.
The AI provider still controls response quality and availability. These changes make failures easier to recover from, but cannot guarantee that an external service is always online.

title: A clearer identity for Rocket 2.0
imageAlt: A green star surrounded by a thin circular orbit.
summary: Rocket 2.0 became the public name for the chat experience, giving the product a more consistent identity across its landing page and app.
body: The naming update distinguishes the chat product, Rocket 2.0, from the RocketGPT company brand. The goal is to make the product easier to identify wherever people arrive on the site.
Rocket 2.0 remains a browser-based AI chat experience for questions, writing, planning, and creative ideas.
